title: Chest X-ray of (MAS) infant with severe Type I Meconium Aspiration Syndrome prior to respiratory failure | Health Education Assets Library (HEAL)
description: Chest X-ray of baby with severe Type I Meconium Aspiration Syndrome (MAS) just prior to respiratory failure (RF) requiring mechanical ventilation - noting patchy infiltrates or areas of atelectasis scattered throughout markedly over-expanded lungs (predominantly on the right) due to air-trapping.
